summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, building embedded firmware in C and Python across STM32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi and Jetson platforms. Wrote bare-metal device drivers (I2C, ADC, timers, UART) and shipped a Bluetooth Classic wearable and a Flutter-to-firmware voice pipeline with speech and audio processing. Comfortable with Git, CMake and Linux build workflows.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth Classic to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 embedded firmware in C: timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture and a low-level I2C device driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled pick-and-place system across a Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server and Jetson+Arduino firmware; integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s).
Resolved 11 integration failures (servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; deployed the Jetson bridge as a systemd service with auto-restart.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end speech ASR pipeline in Python: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder and 4-block causal Transformer decoder; achieved 15% WER on Indian-English NPTEL data.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART; implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
